title: SCO National Coordinators' Meeting Opens in Pakistan with Indian Delegation
detail: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) national coordinators' meeting has commenced in Pakistan, with India participating as part of the multilateral forum. The engagement marks a notable diplomatic interaction amid the ongoing comprehensive bilateral freeze between India and Pakistan, which has seen no ambassadors exchanged and near-zero formal trade since May 2025.

media.caption: SCO national coordinators meet in Pakistan with India among participating delegations

title: India Rejects Turkish President Erdoğan's UNGA Kashmir References as 'Unwarranted'
detail: India's Ministry of External Affairs formally rejected Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's references to Kashmir made during his address at the UN General Assembly, calling them 'unwarranted.' The rebuke signals continued diplomatic friction between New Delhi and Ankara over the disputed territory and reinforces India's consistent position that the Kashmir issue is a bilateral matter between India and Pakistan.

media.caption: India rejects Turkish President Erdoğan's references to Kashmir at UNGA as unwarranted
